name: Aasimar
abilities: Celestial Resistance: resistance to Necrotic and Radiant damage.
Healing Hands: as a Magic action, touch a creature and heal d4s equal to your proficiency bonus; once per Long Rest.
Light Bearer: know the Light cantrip (Charisma is the spellcasting ability for it).
Celestial Revelation: at level 3, as a Bonus Action, transform for 1 minute once per Long Rest; choose the option each time you activate it.

activated_choices.when: each time Celestial Revelation is activated

options.name: Heavenly Wings
options.description: Gain a Fly Speed equal to your Speed for the duration.

options.name: Inner Radiance
options.description: Shed bright and dim light; at the end of each of your turns, each creature within 10 feet takes Radiant damage equal to your proficiency bonus.

options.name: Necrotic Shroud
options.description: Once on each of your turns, one target you damage with an attack or spell takes extra Necrotic damage equal to your proficiency bonus, and nearby creatures may be frightened when you transform.

name: Dragonborn
abilities: Breath Weapon: when you take the Attack action, replace one attack with a 15-foot cone or 30-foot line (5 feet wide); Dex save; damage scales by level; uses equal to proficiency bonus per Long Rest.
Damage Resistance: gain resistance based on your draconic ancestry.
Draconic Flight: at level 5, as a Bonus Action, gain spectral wings and fly for 10 minutes once per Long Rest.

name: Dwarf
abilities: Dwarven Resilience: resistance to Poison damage and advantage on saving throws to avoid or end the Poisoned condition.
Dwarven Toughness: hit point maximum increases by 1, and increases by 1 again whenever you gain a level.
Stonecunning: as a Bonus Action, gain Tremorsense 60 feet for 10 minutes while on or touching stone; uses equal to proficiency bonus per Long Rest.

name: Elf
abilities: Fey Ancestry: advantage on saving throws to avoid or end the Charmed condition.
Keen Senses: gain proficiency in one of Insight, Perception, or Survival.
Trance: you do not need to sleep, magic cannot put you to sleep, and you can finish a Long Rest in 4 hours of trancelike meditation.

options.name: High Elf
level_1: After each Long Rest, may replace it with another Wizard cantrip

name: Gnome
abilities: Gnomish Cunning: advantage on Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma saving throws.

options.name: Forest Gnome
level_1: Cast Speak with Animals without a slot proficiency-bonus times per Long Rest

options.name: Rock Gnome
level_1: Can spend 10 minutes casting Prestidigitation to create a Tiny clockwork device with one Prestidigitation effect

name: Goliath
abilities: Powerful Build: advantage on any save you make to end the Grappled condition, and you count as one size larger when determining carrying capacity.
Large Form: at level 5, as a Bonus Action, become Large for 10 minutes if you have room; gain advantage on Strength checks and +10 Speed; once per Long Rest.

options.name: Cloud Giant
options.benefit: Cloud's Jaunt: as a Bonus Action, teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space you can see.

options.name: Fire Giant
options.benefit: Fire's Burn: when you hit a target with an attack roll and deal damage, deal an extra 1d10 Fire damage.

options.name: Frost Giant
options.benefit: Frost's Chill: when you hit a target with an attack roll and deal damage, deal an extra 1d6 Cold damage and reduce its Speed by 10 feet until the start of your next turn.

options.name: Hill Giant
options.benefit: Hill's Tumble: when you hit a Large or smaller creature with an attack roll and deal damage, give it the Prone condition.

options.name: Stone Giant
options.benefit: Stone's Endurance: when you take damage, use your Reaction to roll 1d12 + CON modifier and reduce the damage by that total.

options.name: Storm Giant
options.benefit: Storm's Thunder: when you take damage from a creature within 60 feet, use your Reaction to deal 1d8 Thunder damage to that creature.

name: Halfling
abilities: Brave: advantage on saving throws to avoid or end the Frightened condition.
Halfling Nimbleness: move through the space of any creature that is a size larger than you, but you cannot stop there.
Lucky: when you roll a 1 on a d20 Test, reroll the die.
Naturally Stealthy: you can take the Hide action even when obscured only by a creature at least one size larger than you.

name: Human
abilities: Resourceful: gain Heroic Inspiration whenever you finish a Long Rest.
Skillful: gain proficiency in one skill of your choice.
Versatile: gain one Origin feat of your choice.

name: Orc
abilities: Adrenaline Rush: take the Dash action as a Bonus Action and gain temporary hit points equal to your proficiency bonus; uses equal to proficiency bonus per Short or Long Rest.
Relentless Endurance: when reduced to 0 Hit Points but not killed outright, drop to 1 Hit Point instead; once per Long Rest.

name: Tabaxi
source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
abilities: Cat's Claws: you have a climbing speed equal to your speed, and your claws can be used to make unarmed strikes that deal slashing damage.
Cat's Talent: gain proficiency in Perception and Stealth.
Feline Agility: when you move on your turn in combat, you can double your speed until the end of the turn; once you use this trait, you can't use it again until you move 0 feet on one of your turns.

name: Tiefling
abilities: Otherworldly Presence: know the Thaumaturgy cantrip; it uses the same spellcasting ability as your Fiendish Legacy spells.

rules.applies_to: Fiendish Legacy spells and Otherworldly Presence
